# Robert's Reference Image Library

Images gathered for UI/UX and design inspiration for Political Ascent.

## How to add images

Drop image files here with descriptive names:
`[game/source]-[descriptor].[ext]`

Example: `victoria3-legislation-panel.jpg`

---

## Image Sources (verified accessible — download manually)
